defects.description: Description says Lean the back flat against the wall (back touching wall, body upright or slight recline). spine=14 (POSITIVE = forward lean per corrected convention) takes the back AWAY from the wall. Should be 0 (upright) or slightly negative (slight backward lean into wall).

regression_risk: low — single-pose spine sign correction; aligns pose with back-on-wall description
rationale: CORRECTED CONVENTION: spine + = forward lean, - = backward arch. Description explicitly says Lean the back FLAT against the wall — back must be in contact with wall, which requires upright (spine=0) or slight backward lean. spine=14 takes shoulders forward of hips, peeling the back off the wall. Setting spine=0 (upright against wall). Reducing neck tilt from -8.8 to -4 (softer, matches relaxed casual mood and crosses-ankles-wide stance). Keeping hipAbductL=+10 (adduct/inward, OK for crossing ankle) and hipAbductR=-10 (abduct/outward, matches front foot pointed outward). Keeping leftShoulder=-30 (hands clasped in front, ~53° abduction).
